def check_condition(q):
    if not isinstance(q, int) or q <= 1:
        return False
    
    # Check if q is prime (simple check for small numbers, since q is expected to be prime)
    def is_prime(n):
        if n <= 1: return False
        for i in range(2, int(math.sqrt(n)) + 1):
            if n % i == 0:

        return True

    if not is_prime(q):

        return True
